nodes.label: Subtitles Studio Page
nodes.rationale: Erase burned-in subs -> burn new word-timed captions -> edit any caption line and fast re-burn (plus Claude '/api/aifix' proofreading). Deliberately splits work across two engines: erase/restore on this server's proven pipeline (width-16 ProPainter fix, auto-detect, corruption retry) via /api/clean-subs; captions/AI-fix on the merged 5180 engine proxied at /subs. Same data root; jobs merged from both /api/jobs endpoints and stopped on the engine that owns them.
